note: the record survives an update's reload: the stash is written, read once, and only for the build now running

js: feature_Scroll.stash(localStorage.misoVersion); const s = JSON.parse(localStorage.misoScroll); return Object.keys(s.at).length > 0 && String(s.v) === String(localStorage.misoVersion)
name: the stash holds the record, keyed by the build

js: feature_Scroll.at.clear(); feature_Scroll.resume(); const gone = localStorage.misoScroll === undefined; return gone && feature_Scroll.at.size > 0
name: resume reads it once and deletes the key
